item.title: BINI Defines What It Means to Be a Global Force & More | Billboard Women In Music 2026
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, I've got some exciting news to share with you. Recently, the popular group BINI had the chance to catch up with some big names in the music industry.
[Short music transition]
Host: They met up with Drew Afualo and Lyndsey Havens from Billboard on the red carpet at a very special event - the Billboard Women in Music 2026. It's always great to see talented artists coming together to celebrate the best in the business.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for now, thanks for tuning in. We'll keep you updated on more exciting music news and events.
